player_prompt.intro:
I nih hi Player {player_id} ni Wild Tic Tac Toe-ah.
I turn ah, i chuan 'X' emaw 'O' i chawi thei e.
I hnehsawm thei via mark pakhat (X or O) a rualin a awm.
I hnehsawm thei via symbol pakhat.
I move i thlan dan chu '[X 4]' format hi hman rawh 'X' center-ah a thlen nan

invalid_move.wrong_format: Move format a dik lo. '[X 4]' emaw '[O 2]' format hi si la
invalid_move.invalid_cell: Cell number diklo: {cell}. 0 leh 8 inkâra awm tûr a ni.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Hnawhchham diklo. Cell {cell} chu a awm tawh reng e.

game_action.placed: Player {player_id} an symbol a neih ({mark}) cell {cell}-ah a thlen
